# WSR test corpus

Drop legally-obtained WonderSwan `.wsr` rips here to exercise the WSR plugin
against real tunes. The `wsr` test case in `src/test.cpp` plays every file in
this directory and reports how many produced sound. The directory is allowed to
be empty (the deterministic part of the test uses a synthetic rip instead), so
no copyrighted material is committed to the repo.
